name: Andrew Morrison

bio.statement: Ballotpedia records that Andrew Morrison, a Republican, ran for Oregon House District 48 in 2024 and lost the primary.
bio.excerpt: Andrew Morrison (Republican Party) ran for election to the Oregon House of Representatives to represent District 48.

source.publisher: Ballotpedia

bio.statement: His pamphlet statement lists Morrison's occupation as software executive with a background in business, technology and sales.
bio.excerpt: Occupation: Software Executive Occupational Background: Business, Technology, Sales

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition), p. 55

bio.statement: His pamphlet statement lists Warner Pacific College and Portland State University as his educational background.
bio.excerpt: Educational Background: Warner Pacific College, Portland State University

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition), p. 55

bio.statement: His pamphlet statement lists the Gresham Chamber Government Affairs Committee as his prior governmental experience.
bio.excerpt: Prior Governmental Experience: Gresham Chamber Government Affairs Committee

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition), p. 55

positions.statement: Morrison's pamphlet statement lists affordability as a priority: supporting working families, encouraging economic growth and helping small businesses succeed.
positions.excerpt: Affordability: Help lower the cost of living by supporting working families, encouraging economic growth, and creating an environment where small businesses can succeed.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition), p. 55

positions.statement: Morrison's pamphlet statement lists supporting law enforcement and first responders to keep neighborhoods, schools and businesses safe.
positions.excerpt: Public Safety: Support law enforcement and first responders to keep neighborhoods, schools, and businesses safe.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition), p. 55

positions.statement: Morrison's pamphlet statement lists ensuring a quality education for students and giving parents choice in their child's education.
positions.excerpt: Education: Ensure students receive a quality education that prepares them for the future and offers parents choice in their child’s education.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition), p. 55

positions.statement: Morrison's pamphlet statement lists responsible investment in infrastructure and utilities that strengthen communities and support growth.

positions.statement: Morrison's pamphlet statement lists transparent, responsible budgeting and effective spending of taxpayer dollars.
